description: The source describes a code effective September 30,1996 for construction and operation of tanker-truck washing facilities. It requires washing on an impervious pad preventing waste discharge, waste recovery and transfer to an approved facility, retention of waste information for five years and immediate contravention reporting. These are direct facility design and operating constraints. The legal-publication descriptor is a URI without a format or edition.
